summary: Iter-23: end-to-end tested Effect Intensity (per-user + per-tenant), Client Cursor Voting flow, Builder Undo/Redo, and Chat Attachment Inbox. All 9 backend pytest tests pass; every frontend acceptance criterion verified in the live preview URL — no critical or minor issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /me/preferences uses raw dict body — no Pydantic schema; consider a typed model to reject unknown keys and improve OpenAPI. Not blocking (unknown keys are silently ignored; clamping + numeric validation are correct).

ui_cms.py apply_cursor_vote has no endpoint to CLEAR a stored vote, so the 404 branch ('No client vote yet') is only reachable on fresh apps that never voted. Consider a DELETE /apps/{id}/cursor-vote for QA + client 'undo my vote' UX.

Attachments.jsx parses body text with a regex against '/api/public/files/' — works, but couples the frontend to an exact URL substring. If the storage endpoint path is ever renamed, thumbnails will silently vanish. A dedicated `attachments` array on the message model would be more robust.
Builder.jsx history is kept in-memory only; navigating away or refreshing drops the past/future stacks. That is fine for now, but future 'crash recovery' work should serialize to localStorage.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iter-23 all-green.

Backend endpoints validated end-to-end:
 • PATCH /api/me/preferences: cursor_density + cursor_speed persist through GET /auth/me; clamped 0.2..3.0 (99→3.0, -5→0.2); non-numeric → 400.
 • GET/PUT /api/apps/{id}/theme: cursor_effect, cursor_density, cursor_speed round-trip cleanly (_clean_theme keeps them because they're in DEFAULT_THEME).
 • Export ZIP site/index.html contains data-cursor-fx / data-cursor-density / data-cursor-speed on <body>.
 • POST /api/apps/{id}/cursor-vote: stores {effect,label,by,at,applied:false}; unknown effect → 400.
 • GET /api/apps/{id}/cursor-vote: returns {vote, current}.
 • POST /api/apps/{id}/cursor-vote/apply: owner/admin sets theme.cursor_effect and marks vote applied; non-owner member → 403.
 • Non-owner MEMBER (via /apps/{id}/members invite) CAN cast+read a vote but CANNOT apply — verified live.

Frontend verified in preview URL:
 • Header cursor-fx-picker-btn opens menu with cursor-fx-density-slider + cursor-fx-speed-slider; changing them updates canvas data-density/data-speed live, persists across reload (PATCH /me/preferences debounced), reset button returns both to 1.0.
 • /portal renders CursorFXVoting (cursor-fx-voting); hovering cursor-vote-option-{id} previews live, click selects, cursor-vote-btn casts, cursor-vote-status shows 'You voted: <label>'.
 • Site Mode for tenant shows cursor-vote-banner naming effect + voter after a fresh vote; cursor-vote-apply-btn applies theme, banner disappears, and /portal status becomes 'Applied'.
 • Per-tenant sliders theme-cursor_density-input / theme-cursor_speed-input show when a non-'none' effect is selected; after Save, /p/{token} canvas carries the tenant density/speed/effect on the public preview.
 • builder-undo-btn / builder-redo-btn work by click and start disabled; adding a block enables undo (14→15→undo→14→redo→15), and Ctrl+Z on window replicates click behavior.
 • Inline text editing (contenteditable in builder-canvas): typing 'ZZZ' + Ctrl+Z does NOT change block count (block history untouched) — InlineTextTools stopPropagation works.
 • Attachments: chat message with '[attachment] name — url' produces lead-attachment-pill on both /leads rows and Inbox rows; detail panes show lead-detail-attachments / inbox-attachments with lead-attachment-item thumbnails; href resolves to /api/public/files/... and is openable.

Regressions spot-checked: theme select still saves, builder-save-btn still works, chat upload still returns 200, cursor effects (iter-22) still switch cleanly.

Cleanup executed post-test: admin cursor_effect='none' + cursor_density=1 + cursor_speed=1; tenant theme cursor_effect='none' + density=1 + speed=1. The seeded TEST_member_* user + test_attach.png lead remain (harmless; the lead helps future regression). The cursor_vote on app_bdbf27abe643 is now applied:true (matrix -> then fairy), i.e. banner is hidden; next tester should cast a fresh vote to see the banner path again.
